facts.quote: Stay in Australia for up to 2 years with members of the family unit

facts.value: In or outside Australia, not in immigration clearance
facts.quote: Apply for the visa in or outside Australia but not in immigration clearance

facts.value: Outside Australia and staying less than 3 months: a supporter, no sponsor
facts.quote: You don’t need a sponsor to apply for this visa if you: apply outside Australia, and intend to stay in Australia for less than 3 months You must have a supporter to apply for this visa.

facts.value: In Australia, or outside it and staying more than 3 months: a sponsor
facts.quote: You need a sponsor to apply for this visa if you: apply in Australia, or apply outside Australia and intend to stay for more than 3 months

facts.value: A contract for the performance or work in Australia
facts.quote: You must have a contract for your performance or work in Australia.

facts.value: Enough money to support yourself during the stay
facts.quote: You must have enough money during your stay in Australia to support yourself and any dependent family members who travel to Australia with you.

facts.value: Performing in a film or television production, subsidised by government or not
facts.quote: performing in a film or television production subsidised by government / performing in a film or television production not subsidised by government

facts.value: The sponsor or supporter consults the relevant union and obtains an Arts certificate
facts.quote: Your sponsor or supporter must consult with the relevant union or unions before engaging you. They must also obtain an Arts certificate from the Department of Communications and the Arts.

facts.value: Times and places of engagements in the application can’t change without the Department’s permission
facts.quote: You must not change the times and places of engagements specified in the application. If you need to do so, you must ask the Secretary of the Department of Home Affairs for permission before you make any changes.

facts.value: If the sponsor or supporter stops the work: a new visa if eligible, or leave within 28 days
facts.quote: leave Australia within 28 days of stopping work for your sponsor/supporter, or earlier if your visa is expiring

facts.value: Travel in and out while valid; time outside doesn’t extend it
facts.quote: You can travel outside Australia and return as many times as you want while the visa is valid. The time you spend outside Australia does not extend the visa.

facts.value: Digitally linked to the passport, no label
facts.quote: We will digitally link your visa to your passport. You will not get a label in your passport.

facts.value: Unknown: the page loads the price from the Visa Pricing Estimator, and the retrieved page holds no figure
facts.quote: The visa costs   for the main applicant.

facts.value: Unknown: the page points to the processing time guide tool
facts.quote: For an indication of processing times for this visa, use the visa processing time guide tool.
